pages.text: $(italic)Botania$() interfaces with redstone through mana, not wire — the $(bold)Redstone Root$(), $(bold)Red Stringed Comparator$(), $(bold)Mana Detector$(), and $(bold)Detector Luminizer$(). They're listed here for completeness; the $(italic)Lexica Botania$() explains them in their own terms.
pages.title: Botania

pages.text: That's the catalogue. If a block emits, reads, or reacts to a signal and it isn't here, it almost certainly belongs to $(italic)Create$() — check the Compendium — or it's brand new to the pack. Tell the pack author and it'll earn a page.
pages.title: The End of the Line
